titles.title: Campus Lifeline Act
Campus Lifeline Act

A bill to amend the Public Health Service Act to modify the grant program for mental health and substance use disorder services for students in higher education and the National Suicide Prevention Lifeline program to address youth suicide prevention and intervention, and for other purposes.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.
